messages:
Nina Park: Heads-up: partners want a minimal onboarding IaC bundle for the marketplace lane. Goal: single repo that reviewers can run within 30m. Keep it tiny — VPC+compute+lb, minimal app, packaging notes. Target: prototype by mid-week.
Sanjay Gupta: I can sketch repo layout. Suggest `modules/{aws,gcp}`, `examples/marketplace`, `docs/packaging.md`, `scripts/pack-manifest.sh`.
Leah Ortiz: I'll own docs/packaging.md and the reviewer checklist. Keep checklist < 1 page. Include KMS optional, network hardened defaults, and the consent/privacy pointer.
Omar Haddad: I'll build the AWS module. Will support `ami_id` and a `use_pipeline_image` boolean. Small Packer example instead of full pipeline.
Sanjay Gupta: I'll mirror for GCP — instance template + MIG. Add `startup-script.sh` and `cloudbuild.yaml` example.
Nina Park: Nice. For reviewers we should expose outputs: load_balancer_dns, instance_template_id, image_used. Call those out in packaging.md.
Leah Ortiz: Also include a short `testing.md` with `make test-aws` / `make test-gcp` that runs terraform apply and curl to /health. CI should run tflint & tfsec.
DevRel Bot: Tip: include a `README.marketplace.md` in examples that lists submission steps and common pitfalls.
Legal Ops: Quick note: please add a small `compliance-checklist.md` referencing the internal CIS baseline and where to find logs/audit configs. We'll need that before submission.
Omar Haddad: snippet for module instantiation I'll add to docs:
```terraform
module "market_core" { source = "./modules/aws" region = var.region ami_id = var.ami_id }
```
Sanjay Gupta: Action items: Omar = AWS module + Packer example, Sanjay = GCP module + cloudbuild, Leah = packaging.md + reviewer checklist, Nina = coordinate legal sign-off and release date. I'll scaffold repo now and push skeleton.
Nina Park: Please drop PRs here. If anyone hits marketplace policy, flag me and Legal Ops. Aim to have prototype by Wed EOD. :rocket:
